brief:
Israeli occupation bulldozers demolished five residential structures and a sheep shelter on Thursday in the Wadi Al-Beik area of Anata town, northeast of occupied Jerusalem, according to the Jerusalem Governorate, IMEMC News reported. The demolitions displaced around 30 Palestinians from their homes.

The operation targeted both housing and livestock facilities in the area. Anata, situated in the periphery of occupied Jerusalem, has faced repeated demolition campaigns by Israeli forces in recent years.
